item.title: Israeli startup launches quantum-safe encryption platform
item.dc:creator: Tech Desk
item.description: A Tel Aviv startup unveiled a platform to protect data against quantum attacks.
item.content:encoded: A Tel Aviv startup unveiled a platform designed to protect enterprise data against future quantum-computing attacks. The company said its post-quantum cryptography stack is already in pilot with several banks.
